purpose: Measure the current-f01e Qwen3.8 AutoRound TP2/MTP0/PIECEWISE/F16 exact-context graph profile at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 24K, and 32K in one server lifetime. Require exact same-image TP2 eager target parity, objective and baseline quality, graph identity, both TP2 workers, rank-scoped cache isolation, cache zero, and strict cleanup. Preserve every historical and protected result.

same_image_same_topology_eager.gate: All six candidate outputs must exactly match the 128 token IDs from this current-image, same-topology target-only eager oracle. The full quality battery must pass objective gates and baseline_match_all against its frozen quality receipt.

dated_graph_comparison.identity_difference: The dated comparison used b2dd9ce73d/1e90ffa672, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, capture sizes 1 and 2, gpu-memory-utilization 0.9, and a different cache identity.
dated_graph_comparison.policy: Pin and record token comparison only. A mismatch is a dated cross-runtime caveat, never a rejection of an otherwise current-f01e exact graph cell and never a speed floor.

exact_depth_contract.depth_zero_reason: The vLLM exact-depth fixture has no literal empty serving request; configured capacity and an ordinary prompt do not fill x=0.

quality_contract.objective_gate: pass_all, seven exact cases, eight-repeat one-hash determinism, one long-context needle, and cached_tokens == 0 on all 16 usage records
quality_contract.same_topology_gate: baseline_match_all must be true against the frozen current-f01e TP2 eager quality receipt

required_startup_markers: Compiling a graph for compile range
graph_contract.cache_policy: fresh ext4 cache; only rank_0_0 and rank_1_0 rank namespaces are allowed, while shared AOT/cache support files are inventoried separately
graph_contract.runtime_disclosure: Multi-GPU XPU graph is labeled unsupported/experimental by the runtime; a passing result remains Grade C profile-specific evidence.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-piecewise-depth: All six exact depths, same-image eager target parity, objective and same-topology quality, PIECEWISE markers, TP2 topology, rank cache isolation, and cleanup pass.
terminal_classification.partial-depth-expansion: Global gates pass but fewer than six depths pass exact request plus current-f01e eager target parity; freeze only valid depths and infer nothing.
terminal_classification.quarantined-target-or-quality-failed: Any same-image target divergence or objective/baseline quality failure quarantines that evidence; retain every receipt without publication authority.
terminal_classification.failed: Identity, graph mechanism, topology, cache isolation, model verification, or cleanup fails; retain evidence and authorize nothing.
